subject: MAP draft & alignment on procurement/contract signature deadline
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Torres <lina.torres@fintechco.com>, Arjun Patel <arjun.patel@fintechco.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft & next steps (target close May 31)

Hi Lina / Arjun —

Great to meet earlier today. Thanks for the time and for walking through the integration patterns. Per our call I’m attaching a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that outlines milestones, owners, and the proposed target close date. High-level summary: 

- Target close: May 31, 2027 (contract signature)
- Key milestones:
  - Technical evaluation complete (FintechCo + Redwood): May 10
  - Security review & SOC2 evidence review: May 14
  - Procurement redlines & legal review: May 20
  - Final exec approval & signature: May 31
- Responsibilities:
  - Redwood: provide MAP draft, SOC2 artifact access, SOW template, dev support for POC
  - FintechCo: complete integration tests, provide security questionnaire answers, route PO to procurement
- Dependencies: SSO/KMS integration details from FintechCo; procurement lead availability for final signature

Action items I’m proposing now:
1) Please review the attached MAP (redwood-map-draft-v2.pdf) and flag any timeline conflicts by May 5.
2) Camila (cc’d) will set up weekly 30-min syncs for technical follow-up starting next Tue.
3) If procurement has an earlier signature constraint, let us know — we can try to shorten the legal review window.

Attaching SOW-template.docx for procurement reference.

Thanks — happy to adjust timelines to meet any internal sign-off deadlines.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
(650) 555-0199

Subject: Re: MAP draft & next steps (target close May 31)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the concise MAP and the attachments. Quick notes from procurement/legal side: 

- Our internal procurement window requires final contract signature by May 20 to hit our June budget cycle. If we miss that, approval will move to the July cycle.
- Security has a couple of follow-ups on KMS integration and data residency; I’m looping Lina to coordinate the security artifact handoff.
- We’re generally aligned on the technical milestones, but the legal review window needs to be shortened. Can you confirm Redwood’s standard turnaround on redline reviews?

If Redwood can compress the legal review slot (we’re expecting a 2–3 business day turnaround), we should be able to hit May 20 for signature. Otherwise our target would slip to May 31 as you proposed. 

Thanks — copying procurement so they see the MAP.

—Arjun
Arjun Patel
Head of Partnerships
FintechCo

Thanks Arjun — this is helpful and appreciate the procurement timing clarity. Quick internal update and proposed plan to meet your May 20 signature target: 

1) Legal turnaround: Redwood legal (Ethan cc’d) can prioritize your packet. Our standard is 3–5 business days on first-pass redlines; if you send redlines by EOD May 12 we can aim for a first response by May 15. Ethan, can you confirm we can accelerate to 2 business days for this deal if needed?

2) Security artifacts: Camila will share SOC2 evidence and a brief KMS integration runbook by EOD May 6. Lina — please confirm the required KMS details (HSM vendor, key rotation policy) so we can include them in the runbook.

3) Revised MAP milestones (proposed to support May 20 signature):
  - Tech eval complete: May 10 (on track)
  - Security artifact handoff: May 6 (Redwood) / May 9 (FintechCo confirmation)
  - Legal redlines submitted: May 12 (FintechCo)
  - Redwood legal first-pass: May 15
  - Final exec approval & signature: May 20

If FintechCo confirms redlines will be submitted by May 12, we’re green to target May 20 for signature. Otherwise we’ll maintain May 31 as fallback.

Next steps:
- Arjun / Procurement: confirm whether your team can deliver redlines by May 12.
- Lina: confirm KMS details and any additional security evidence you need.
- Camila / Ethan: I’ll let you take point on artifacts/redline turnaround internally.

Thanks — I’ll update the MAP and send a new version once we have confirmation.

Best,
Marissa
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
